content: In the context of EthIf_CtrlModeIndication the function EthTrcv_TransceiverLinkStateRequest shall be called if the EthIfController has a reference to a EthIfTransceiver. If EthIfController was called with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE, then EthTr cv_TransceiverLinkStateRequest shall be called with ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ACTIVE. If EthIfController was called with ETH_MODE_DOWN, then EthTrcv_TransceiverLinkStateRequest shall be called with ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN.
